title: Half-percent general excise tax surcharge
summary: On June 19, 2023, the vice chair asked the department for estimates of what a GET surcharge could cover. He said a half-percent surcharge could pay for water and sewer infrastructure for housing. In February 2023, he had said he would look into whether a proposed half-percent tax could help pay for cesspool conversion.

upcomingEvent.what: A council member moved to require that the surcharge end no later than December 31, 2030.
